world 1 (key tactical).reader_note: Needs the petition-start and withdrawal-end sentences together, but each distractor is killed by a planted phrase ("two councils signed", "almost no cut weirs").

world 2 (key token).reader_note: Token requires combining the renewed feasts with weirs cut at the old rate and no fines; 'signed a truce' kills tacit and 'two councils signed' kills unilateral, tactical is defensible.

world 0 (key tacit).reader_note: 'No agreement appears in either town's minutes or letters' gives tacit almost alone; 'almost no cut weirs' kills token and both towns acting kills unilateral.

world 2 (key shelved).reader_note: Needs "needed more time" over twenty years plus "without a single pencil mark"; the pencil-mark line kills updated and sanitized.

world 3 (key updated).reader_note: Easy: 'horse carts have become trucks, the dockers earn the wages of 1932' says updated outright; 'every chapter is present' kills sanitized.

world 0 (key salvaged).reader_note: "dried and separated them one at a time ... copied out nearly every word" gives salvaged outright.

world 1 (key sanitized).reader_note: Debts/cursing/tavern softened to dressmaker/'sir'/tea shop; 'printed' kills shelved and the unchanged 1880s setting kills updated.

world 3 (key trophy).reader_note: Keys in procession and painting behind the throne point to trophy; heavy garrison spending at a strait mouth keeps watchtower partly alive.

world 0 (key storehouse).reader_note: Easy: 'stacked in warehouses built along the harbor' names the key almost literally; 'almost no trade of its own' kills tollgate.

world 1 (key tollgate).reader_note: "had to anchor under the port's guns and pay a duty on its cargo" gives tollgate outright.

world 2 (key watchtower).reader_note: 'From the island's single hill a lookout could see forty miles of the strait' gives watchtower; 'thin soil and almost no trade' kills storehouse and tollgate.

world 0 (key stronghold).reader_note: "the one title in town they could not acquire, and inside its walls the old price agreement ... still held" gives stronghold.

world 1 (key springboard).reader_note: 'most who finished them leaving the looms within a few years for city offices' gives springboard; falling membership kills stronghold.

world 2 (key showpiece).reader_note: Buyers walked through before prices plus meetings held elsewhere so nothing looked worn gives showpiece; stone hall tempts stronghold.

world 1 (key watchdog).reader_note: "read aloud ... every payment the council had made without a vote" plus members repaying gives watchdog; distractors are weak.

world 3 (key tiebreaker).reader_note: "gave the secretary a vote only when the members were evenly divided" gives tiebreaker outright.

world 0 (key tamed).reader_note: Broken legs fell while scrum and crowds stayed; "towns and villages alike" kills urbanized and "remained the heart of every match" kills splintered/unbalanced.

world 2 (key splintered).reader_note: "By 1880 the county had two codes of football ... a club from one never met a club from the other" gives splintered directly.

world 3 (key urbanized).reader_note: Village clubs disband and survivors are in mill or market towns gives urbanized; tamed and unbalanced are plausible near-misses.

world 3 (key seedbed).reader_note: "nearly every young herring caught past the quays hatched in those pools" gives seedbed; the hydrology terms are surface lures only.

world 1 (key sieve).reader_note: Silt settling and dye binding plus gauges showing equal flow in and out (kills sponge) gives sieve/filter.

world 2 (key spillway).reader_note: Overflow over a bank and passed to the bay within a day gives spillway; sponge is the near-miss, killed only by 'within a day' and the creeks emptying into the bay.

world 3 (key unearthed).reader_note: No collector had found it and the aunt was the last who knew it, so unearthed; 'hard, plain style' kills sweetened, but standardized is defensible since the record fixed one version others took up.

world 0 (key standardized).reader_note: "nearly every singer ... sang the record's seven verses to the record's tune" gives standardized outright.

world 1 (key sweetened).reader_note: Soft orchestra, smooth tenor, 'easier on the ear' give sweetened; 'arranged two more hill ballads the same way' makes standardized a near-miss.
